premises.text: CodeGuard backs up sites via FTP/SFTP, monitors for changes on a schedule, and takes new snapshots when changes are found
premises.evidence_span: we back up your site. Right now, we use FTP or SFTP

premises.text: One-button undo reverts site changes whether wanted or unwanted
premises.evidence_span: if anything happens to your site, whether it was wanted or unwanted, that you want to revert, you can do it with just one button

premises.text: Owners can configure monitoring to auto-push the last version when differences appear (e.g., vacation AdWords/malware case)
premises.evidence_span: if it notices anything is different, I want it to repair by pushing the last version

premises.text: Product is Git-based version control made easy for non-experts
premises.evidence_span: Our system is built upon Git, developed by Linus Torvalds. It's an industry-leading source version control tool. But we provide it for the masses

value.text: Time-machine style website protection with one-button revert
value.evidence_span: We are a time machine for your website

causal_links.evidence_span: you can do it with just one button

notes: Change-only snapshot uniqueness folded into P1 backup/monitor mechanism (v1.3.2 feature fold). cPanel plugins treated as roadmap detail of FTP path, not separate premise.
